title: Fatal accident on SP-255 highway leaves two young people dead
seoTitle: Fatal Crash on SP-255 Highway Leaves Two Dead
subtitle: Gabriel Souza Santos, 17, and Ágata Priscila da Silva, 19, lost their lives in an accident on the night of September 7
excerpt: A Jeep Renegade attempted an illegal overtake and collided head-on with a Ford Focus on the SP-255 highway in Bocaina, resulting in Gabriel Souza's death.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: G1, sampi.net.br, São Carlos em Rede
contentHtml:
An accident involving a Jeep Renegade and a Ford Focus on the Comandante João Ribeiro de Barros highway (SP-255) left two fatalities and three injured on the night of September 7, Independence Day.

How the head-on collision occurred

According to Artesp's Multimodal Control Center (CCM), the Jeep Renegade attempted an illegal overtake at km 135 of the southbound lane, heading towards Jaú. The vehicle collided head-on with the Ford Focus, which was traveling in the opposite direction. The impact caused the Renegade to overturn across the lane and the Focus to hit the metal guardrail.

Fatal victims and injured

Ágata Priscila da Silva, 19, died at the scene. Gabriel Souza Santos, 17, was rescued and taken to the hospital in Jaú, but did not survive. Two other people sustained moderate injuries and were treated at the municipality's health units.

Procedures after the accident

The highway lanes were immediately closed. The Highway Military Police provided assistance and the Civil Police began investigating the causes. All lanes were reopened in the early hours of September 8, with no traffic congestion reported.

Community reactions

The city hall of Bocaina published a statement of condolence, expressing sympathy to the families. In Dourado, where Gabriel resided, his funeral took place at the municipal cemetery on the afternoon of September 8. In Boa Esperança do Sul, where Ágata lived, the burial took place on September 9.

Impact on the region

The accident resonated in the cities of Dourado, Boa Esperança do Sul, and neighboring communities, which lost two young people who were described as beloved, studious, and active in local routines. The tragedy reinforces the importance of respecting overtaking rules and the need for safety measures on highways.
